items.title: Earwax’s surprisingly slippery but sticky properties deters insects
items.summary: A comprehensive study of earwax reveals a combination of slippery and sticky properties that may protect against insect invasions of the ear.

items.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop a wearable monitor for early disease detection
items.summary: Awarded up to $38 million from ARPA-H, the team aims to create a low-power, noninvasive sensor patch that measures heart failure and sepsis biomarkers in real-time.
